activity_summary: At Bishopsgate you read the Rose's new title twice. A Toy to Please Chaste Ladies. The bill names no author and no receipt. You did not cross the river. You are Egeon at two.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the title, and turned toward the Theatre.
